What it is

  • A SQLite database for a quick-service restaurant ERP, built from the group's logical ERD: sales import, recipes and inventory, staff scheduling and labor cost, and threshold alerts, with reporting views and a deterministic generator for four weeks of sample data for a fictional pizza shop. #qsr-erp-database
  • The app framework the team builds on: a Flask screen loader that registers each screen folder and refuses to start on a broken one, PBKDF2 login with role guards and CSRF checks on every POST, a base template, shared components, and a starter stylesheet for teammates to edit. #qsr-erp-framework
  • I designed the database and the app's architecture, built the framework screens and base styling, and am leading the team through implementation. Teammates own the data visualisation and the queries that put data on each screen. #qsr-erp-role
